audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua Rahab-and-spies narrative, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for covert espionage, Rahab's occupation and agency, royal pursuit, concealed spies, Exodus/Sihon/Og memory, covenant oath, scarlet cord, household sanctuary, and return report.

verses.restored: Joshua son of Nun sent from Shittim two men as spies secretly, saying, Go, see the land and Jericho. They went and came to house of a woman, a prostitute/sex worker, whose name was Rahab, and they lay/stayed there.

familiar.text: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

modern.text: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim, saying, “Go, inspect the land, especially Jericho.” So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֠וּן מִֽן הַשִּׁטִּ֞ים שְׁנַֽיִם אֲנָשִׁ֤ים מְרַגְּלִים֙ חֶ֣רֶשׁ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְכ֛וּ רְא֥וּ אֶת הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֶת יְרִיח֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ בֵּית אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֛ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ רָחָ֖ב וַיִּשְׁכְּבוּ שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: It was told to king of Jericho, saying, Look, men from children of Israel came here tonight to search out the land.

familiar.text: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

modern.text: And it was reported to the king of Jericho: “Behold, some men of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land.”

original.text: וַיֵּ֣אָמַ֔ר לְמֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה אֲ֠נָשִׁים בָּ֣אוּ הֵ֧נָּה הַלַּ֛יְלָה מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַחְפֹּ֥ר אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: King of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, Bring out the men who came to you, who entered your house, for they came to search out all the land.

familiar.text: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

modern.text: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab and said, “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, for they have come to spy out the whole land.”

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְרִיח֔וֹ אֶל רָחָ֖ב לֵאמֹ֑ר ה֠וֹצִיאִי הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים הַבָּאִ֤ים אֵלַ֨יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אוּ לְבֵיתֵ֔ךְ כִּ֛י לַחְפֹּ֥ר אֶת כָּל הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּֽאוּ

verses.restored: But the woman took the two men and hid them. She said, Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know from where they were.

familiar.text: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

modern.text: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. So she said, “Yes, the men did come to me, but I did not know where they had come from.

original.text: וַתִּקַּ֧ח הָֽאִשָּׁ֛ה אֶת שְׁנֵ֥י הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַֽתִּצְפְּנ֑וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר כֵּ֗ן בָּ֤אוּ אֵלַי֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי מֵאַ֥יִן הֵֽמָּה

verses.restored: It was at closing of gate, at darkness, that the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue quickly after them, for you may overtake them.

familiar.text: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

modern.text: At dusk, when the gate was about to close, the men went out, and I do not know which way they went. Pursue them quickly, and you may catch them!”

original.text: וַיְהִ֨י הַשַּׁ֜עַר לִסְגּ֗וֹר בַּחֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים יָצָ֔אוּ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי אָ֥נָה הָלְכ֖וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֑ים רִדְפ֥וּ מַהֵ֛ר אַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם כִּ֥י תַשִּׂיגֽוּם

verses.restored: But she had brought them up to roof and hidden them with stalks of flax arranged for her upon roof.

familiar.text: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

modern.text: (But Rahab had taken them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had laid out there.)

original.text: וְהִ֖יא הֶעֱלָ֣תַם הַגָּ֑גָה וַֽתִּטְמְנֵם֙ בְּפִשְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ הָעֲרֻכ֥וֹת לָ֖הּ עַל הַגָּֽג

verses.restored: The men pursued after them by way of Jordan as far as fords, and gate was shut after pursuers went out.

familiar.text: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

modern.text: So the king’s men set out in pursuit of the spies along the road to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as they had gone out, the gate was shut. The Promise to Rahab

original.text: וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים רָדְפ֤וּ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶם֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן עַ֖ל הַֽמַּעְבְּר֑וֹת וְהַשַּׁ֣עַר סָגָ֔רוּ אַחֲרֵ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יָצְא֥וּ הָרֹדְפִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Before they lay down, she came up to them upon roof.

familiar.text: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

modern.text: Before the spies lay down for the night, Rahab went up on the roof

original.text: וְהֵ֖מָּה טֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁכָּב֑וּן וְהִ֛יא עָלְתָ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עַל הַגָּֽג

verses.restored: She said to men, I know YHWH has given you the land, and that terror of you has fallen upon us, and all inhabitants of land melt before you.

familiar.text: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

modern.text: and said to them, “I know that the LORD has given you this land and that the fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of you.

original.text: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם אֶת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכִֽי נָפְלָ֤ה אֵֽימַתְכֶם֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְכִ֥י נָמֹ֛גוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: For we heard how YHWH dried up waters of Sea of Reeds before you when you came out from Egypt, and what you did to two kings of Amorite across Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you devoted to destruction.

familiar.text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

modern.text: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites across the Jordan, whom you devoted to destruction.

original.text: כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֗עְנוּ אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת מֵ֤י יַם סוּף֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם בְּצֵאתְכֶ֖ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֡ם לִשְׁנֵי֩ מַלְכֵ֨י הָאֱמֹרִ֜י אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ לְסִיחֹ֣ן וּלְע֔וֹג אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱרַמְתֶּ֖ם אוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: We heard, and our heart melted, and no spirit rose anymore in any man because of you; for YHWH your Divine, he is Divine in heavens above and upon earth beneath.

familiar.text: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

modern.text: When we heard this, our hearts melted and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.

original.text: וַנִּשְׁמַע֙ וַיִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבֵ֔נוּ וְלֹא קָ֨מָה ע֥וֹד ר֛וּחַ בְּאִ֖ישׁ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֤וּא אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּֽחַת

verses.restored: Now therefore, please swear to me by YHWH, because I have done covenant loyalty with you, that you also will do covenant loyalty with house of my father; give me a reliable sign,

familiar.text: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

modern.text: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD that you will indeed show kindness to my family, because I showed kindness to you. Give me a sure sign

original.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּֽׁבְעוּ נָ֥א לִי֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה כִּי עָשִׂ֥יתִי עִמָּכֶ֖ם חָ֑סֶד וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם גַּם אַתֶּ֜ם עִם בֵּ֤ית אָבִי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לִ֖י א֥וֹת אֱמֶֽת

verses.restored: that you will preserve alive my father, my mother, my brothers, my sisters, and all belonging to them, and rescue our souls/lives from death.

familiar.text: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

modern.text: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and that you will deliver us from death.”

original.text: וְהַחֲיִתֶ֞ם אֶת אָבִ֣י וְאֶת אִמִּ֗י וְאֶת אַחַי֙ וְאֶת אחותי וְאֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וְהִצַּלְתֶּ֥ם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖ינוּ מִמָּֽוֶת

verses.restored: The men said to her, Our soul/life in place of yours for death, if you do not tell this matter of ours. It shall be, when YHWH gives us land, that we will do covenant loyalty and faithfulness with you.

familiar.text: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

modern.text: “Our lives for your lives!” the men agreed. “If you do not report our mission, we will show you kindness and faithfulness when the LORD gives us the land.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֧אמְרוּ לָ֣הּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים נַפְשֵׁ֤נוּ תַחְתֵּיכֶם֙ לָמ֔וּת אִ֚ם לֹ֣א תַגִּ֔ידוּ אֶת דְּבָרֵ֖נוּ זֶ֑ה וְהָיָ֗ה בְּתֵת יְהוָ֥ה לָ֨נוּ֙ אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְעָשִׂ֥ינוּ עִמָּ֖ךְ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת

verses.restored: She let them down by rope through window, for her house was in wall of city, and in wall she dwelt.

familiar.text: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

modern.text: Then Rahab let them down by a rope through the window, since the house where she lived was built into the wall of the city.

original.text: וַתּוֹרִדֵ֥ם בַּחֶ֖בֶל בְּעַ֣ד הַֽחַלּ֑וֹן כִּ֤י בֵיתָהּ֙ בְּקִ֣יר הַֽחוֹמָ֔ה וּבַֽחוֹמָ֖ה הִ֥יא יוֹשָֽׁבֶת

verses.restored: She said to them, Go toward hill country, lest pursuers meet you; hide there three days until pursuers return, and afterward go your way.

familiar.text: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

modern.text: “Go to the hill country,” she said, “so that your pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned; then go on your way.”

original.text: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ הָהָ֣רָה לֵּ֔כוּ פֶּֽן יִפְגְּע֥וּ בָכֶ֖ם הָרֹדְפִ֑ים וְנַחְבֵּתֶ֨ם שָׁ֜מָּה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עַ֚ד שׁ֣וֹב הָרֹֽדְפִ֔ים וְאַחַ֖ר תֵּלְכ֥וּ לְדַרְכְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: The men said to her, We shall be free from this oath of yours that you made us swear,

familiar.text: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

modern.text: The men said to her, “We will not be bound by this oath you made us swear

original.text: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יהָ הָאֲנָשִׁ֑ים נְקִיִּ֣ם אֲנַ֔חְנוּ מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵ֥ךְ הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ

verses.restored: unless, when we enter land, you tie this cord of scarlet thread in window by which you let us down, and gather to yourself into house your father, mother, brothers, and all house of your father.

familiar.text: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.

modern.text: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother and brothers and all your family into your house.

original.text: הִנֵּ֛ה אֲנַ֥חְנוּ בָאִ֖ים בָּאָ֑רֶץ אֶת תִּקְוַ֡ת חוּט֩ הַשָּׁנִ֨י הַזֶּ֜ה תִּקְשְׁרִ֗י בַּֽחַלּוֹן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹרַדְתֵּ֣נוּ ב֔וֹ וְאֶת אָבִ֨יךְ וְאֶת אִמֵּ֜ךְ וְאֶת אַחַ֗יִךְ וְאֵת֙ כָּל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔יךְ תַּאַסְפִ֥י אֵלַ֖יִךְ הַבָּֽיְתָה

verses.restored: It shall be, anyone who goes out from doors of your house into street—his blood shall be upon his head, and we shall be innocent; but anyone with you in house—his blood shall be upon our head if a hand is against him.

familiar.text: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

modern.text: If anyone goes out the door of your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be innocent. But if a hand is laid on anyone with you in the house, his blood will be on our heads.

original.text: וְהָיָ֡ה כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא֩ מִדַּלְתֵ֨י בֵיתֵ֧ךְ הַח֛וּצָה דָּמ֥וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֖וֹ וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ נְקִיִּ֑ם וְ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִֽהְיֶ֤ה אִתָּךְ֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת דָּמ֣וֹ בְרֹאשֵׁ֔נוּ אִם יָ֖ד תִּֽהְיֶה בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: But if you tell this matter of ours, then we shall be free from your oath that you made us swear.

familiar.text: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

modern.text: And if you report our mission, we will be released from the oath you made us swear.”

original.text: וְאִם תַּגִּ֖ידִי אֶת דְּבָרֵ֣נוּ זֶ֑ה וְהָיִ֣ינוּ נְקִיִּ֔ם מִשְּׁבֻעָתֵ֖ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ

verses.restored: She said, According to your words, so be it. She sent them away and they went, and she tied scarlet cord in window.

familiar.text: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

modern.text: “Let it be as you say,” she replied, and she sent them away. And when they had gone, she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

original.text: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כְּדִבְרֵיכֶ֣ם כֶּן ה֔וּא וַֽתְּשַׁלְּחֵ֖ם וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַתִּקְשֹׁ֛ר אֶת תִּקְוַ֥ת הַשָּׁנִ֖י בַּחַלּֽוֹן

verses.restored: They went and came to hill country and stayed there three days until pursuers returned. Pursuers searched all way and did not find them.

familiar.text: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

modern.text: So the spies went out into the hill country and stayed there three days, until their pursuers had returned without finding them, having searched all along the road.

original.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ֙ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ הָהָ֔רָה וַיֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים עַד שָׁ֖בוּ הָרֹדְפִ֑ים וַיְבַקְשׁ֧וּ הָרֹדְפִ֛ים בְּכָל הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ וְלֹ֥א מָצָֽאוּ

verses.restored: The two men returned, descended from hill country, crossed over, and came to Joshua son of Nun; they recounted to him all that found them.

familiar.text: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

modern.text: Then the two men started back, came down from the hill country, and crossed the river. So they came to Joshua son of Nun and reported all that had happened to them.

original.text: וַיָּשֻׁ֜בוּ שְׁנֵ֤י הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיֵּרְד֣וּ מֵֽהָהָ֔ר וַיַּעַבְרוּ֙ וַיָּבֹ֔אוּ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נ֑וּן וַיְסַ֨פְּרוּ ל֔וֹ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַמֹּצְא֖וֹת אוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: They said to Joshua, Surely YHWH has given all land into our hand, and also all inhabitants of land melt before us.

familiar.text: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

modern.text: “The LORD has surely delivered the entire land into our hands,” they said to Joshua. “Indeed, all who dwell in the land are melting in fear of us.”

original.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֙ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ כִּֽי נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה בְּיָדֵ֖נוּ אֶת כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ וְגַם נָמֹ֛גוּ כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפָּנֵֽינוּ

translation_notes: Rahab is named zonah, commonly 'prostitute' or 'sex worker.' The occupation should not be euphemized away or used to stigmatize her; the narrative presents her as politically perceptive, strategic, courageous, and capable of negotiating a binding covenant.
The spies' mission and Rahab's deception occur under threat from royal power. The chapter narrates protective lying without offering a simple universal rule about deception.
Rahab's confession of YHWH's sovereignty emerges from reports of liberation and conquest, including the destruction of Sihon and Og; her faith is therefore embedded in a climate of terror.
Her bargain is not only for herself but for an extended household, making the scarlet cord a sign of collective sanctuary.
The oath limits safety to those inside her house. This protection does not morally justify destruction of everyone outside it.
Rahab should not be reduced to a sexualized symbol or used in anti-sex-worker preaching. Her agency, intelligence, and covenant loyalty are central.
The narrative's conquest assumptions and language of inhabitants melting in fear must remain under anti-colonial and anti-terror safeguards.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 2 to stigmatize sex workers, romanticize espionage, justify lying for domination, or imply that one family's rescue makes a city's destruction acceptable. Center Rahab's agency, courageous protection of vulnerable people, negotiated sanctuary, and the moral complexity of survival under approaching war.
